# glad 2.0.8: the OpenGL function loader for desktop GL (OpenGL 3.3
# compatibility profile with anisotropic filtering, KHR_debug and
# NV_copy_image). include/ and src/ are generated by generate.py, which pins the
# glad version and its bundled specification; run it again to change them.
# The compatibility profile is a superset of the core profile, so the new GL
# backend (core) and the old renderers (fixed function) share it. Static and
# private: the engine and the GL backend plugin each load their own copy.
add_library(glad STATIC
	include/glad/gl.h
	include/KHR/khrplatform.h
	src/gl.c
)
target_include_directories(glad PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
# linked into the shared engine library and the plugin
set_target_properties(glad PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
